subcommittees.name: Public Lands, Forests, and Mining Subcommittee

dimensions.assessment: Affects the single owner of record of the approximately 8.43 acres of covered land in Sacramento, California.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'buyer' means the owner of record of any of the parcels included in the covered land

dimensions.assessment: The effect is administrative and transactional, involving the purchase and release of a federal land reversionary interest for fair market value.
dimensions.evidence: convey the lands to buyer upon payment of the appraised value

dimensions.assessment: Involves a single private payment for fair market value plus administrative costs, to be deposited into the Federal Land Disposal Account.
dimensions.evidence: The proceeds from the sale of the applicable reversionary interest shall be deposited in the Federal Land Disposal Account

dimensions.assessment: Applies strictly to a specific 8.43-acre parcel of land and directs a specific federal land conveyance without broad statutory or regulatory changes.
dimensions.evidence: To convey the reversionary interest of the United States in certain land in Sacramento, California.

dimensions.assessment: The conveyance process is a one-time transaction required to be offered within two years of receiving a request from the buyer.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than two years after the Secretary receives a request from the buyer, the Secretary shall offer to the buyer

missing_information: The exact appraised monetary value or purchase price of the reversionary interest is not specified in the source.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs the Bureau of Land Management to offer to sell the federal reversionary interest in approximately 8.43 acres of land in Sacramento, California, to the current owner of record upon payment of fair market value and administrative costs. The impact is narrowly limited to a single specific property and its owner.
